thread:
alex_chen: Heads up — we need to lock down GPU spot contracts for ANZ expansion. Target: 120 A100-eq by end of Q4. What's appetite for spot vs reserved? any vendor leads?
priya_kapoor: +1. intent is to keep cost down but avoid unstable preemptions. thinking 70% reserved, 30% spot to start. timeline ok? Q4 feels tight.
marco_garcia: From infra side — lead times for racks & config in APAC vendor is 8–12 weeks. If we aim for late Q4 rollout, contracts need signatures by mid-Sept.
emily_wu: Product wants 80% availability SLA for customer tier-1 in ANZ. Can we map that to a mix? spot preemptions must fall under fallback policy to hosted models in other regions.
ron_sre: Ops note — we can set autoscale fallback to eu-west as a failover, but cross-region adds egress costs (~$0.02/token est). Also cold KV warming will add ~200ms P95.
finance_bot: FYI budget cap for ANZ infra is $2.2M ARR incremental; spot expected to save 25-35% but volatile. Need a cost model attached to procurement ask.
alex_chen: @marco can you draft vendor shortlist + lead times? @finance_bot can you run quick cost sims for 70/30 and 50/50 mixes?
marco_garcia: Will do. Initial shortlist: VendorA (local colo, 2wk rack lead), VendorB (regional cloud partner, preempt-friendly), VendorC (direct HW lease, 10wk). Pricing ballpark per A100-eq: VendorA $1.6/hr, VendorB spot $0.9/hr, VendorC reserved $1.25/hr.
emily_wu: Launch criteria proposal: 1) 60% of planned capacity live in-region, 2) fallbacks validated under 2x load test, 3) latency P95 < 250ms for core routes. Thoughts?
priya_kapoor: Sounds reasonable. Add customer pilot (3 customers) for 2 weeks before GA.
alex_chen: ok. action items: marco — vendor shortlist + contract timelines by Tue. finance_bot — cost sims by Wed. emily/priya — draft launch criteria doc and pilot plan. We'll sync Wed 11am ANZ. :thumbsup:
